newsitem.title: USA: Maxicare sees higher tax carryforwards.
newsitem.headline: Maxicare sees higher tax carryforwards.

text.p: Maxicare Health Plans Inc said on Tuesday it believes the availability of its pre-change net operating loss carryforwards for tax-return purposes has increased by about $216 million compared with amounts previously quantified as of December 31, 1995.

The company said its belief is based on a tax report received from its independent accountants, Ernst & Young LLP, and the company's understanding regarding the application of Sections 382 and 383 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

As a result of a "change of ownership" experienced by the company on December 5, 1990, $325 million in pre-change net operating loss carryforwards (NOL's) became subject to limitation under Section 382 of the code, it said.

The company believes the annual limitation under Section 382 of the code for its pre-change NOLs has increased from $6.3 million per year to $9.2 million per year, which represents an increase of about $44 million over the carryover period, from $94 million to $138 million.

In addition, the company said it believes about $182 million of additional pre-change NOLs are currently available for federal income tax return purposes as of December 31, 1995, under other provisions of Section 382.

The pre-change NOLs are subject to a 15-year carryover period and expire for federal income tax purposes in the years 2002 through 2005. In the event these pre-change NOLs are not fully utilized in an annual period, the company is allowed to carry over such amounts to subsequent years during the carryover period, the company said.
The company said it believes about $320 million of the total pre-change NOLs of $325 million will be available for utilization for federal income tax return purposes over the carryover period.
It said it is unable to quantify to what extent it may be able to fully utilize its remaining pre-change NOLs for federal income tax return purposes prior to their expiration.
